{{Quote|Attention. unidentified vessel. You are not a scheduled arrival for this system.|Communication from HM7-R to ''The Emperor's Vision''|<ref name="OSG" />}}
'''The Hammer's system''' was a minor [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. It contained a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-gray [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Several [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]], considered to be notoriously stable, were located in the planet's vicinity. The planet was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the refitted [[FireStar-class Orbital Defense Station|space station]] [[HM7-R]].<ref name="OSG" />
